q1: 1. Where can I buy Art Cosmos books?
a1: You can find them on Amazon, Etsy, or via our Beacons link with quick access options.
q2: 2. In what formats are they available?
a2: We offer physical books and digital versions ready to print or use in coloring apps.
q3: 3. How do I choose the right book for me?
a3: Each collection has a different theme and difficulty. From beginners to advanced artists—there's a book for every level!
q4: 4. What coloring tools can I use?
a4: Our books work well with colored pencils, markers, and watercolors. Digital books can also be used with iPad or tablets.
q5: 5. Does the paper support markers or watercolors?
a5: Yes, but we recommend placing a sheet underneath to protect the next page, especially when using alcohol markers.
q6: 6. Are the books suitable for all ages?
a6: Yes, we offer kids’ books, teen-friendly editions, and relaxing books for adults too.
q7: 7. What kind of activities are included at the end of the books?
a7: Many books include mazes, crosswords, word searches, and visual puzzles.
q8: 8. Are the activities for kids or adults?
a8: They are suitable for all ages—relaxing and inspiring after coloring.
q9: 9. Can I photocopy the activities to repeat them?
a9: Yes, if the book is yours, you may print or copy the pages for personal use.
q10: 10. How do I receive my digital books?
a10: You’ll receive a PDF immediately after purchase via Etsy or Beacons.
q11: 11. What paper should I use for printing?
a11: We recommend white paper with at least 90–120 gsm for the best color results.
q12: 12. Can I use the pages in a coloring app?
a12: Yes! Import the PDF into apps like Procreate, Pigment, or Adobe Fresco.
q13: 13. What if I don’t know how to color?
a13: You don’t need to be an artist. There are no mistakes—just creative expression!
q14: 14. What if I get tired or frustrated?
a14: Coloring isn’t a race. You can pause and return anytime. Your book has no deadline!
